extension.summary: Netflix browse UI for Kodi with playback delegated to a DRM-capable client
extension.description: A clean Netflix addon: native Kodi browsing (home, My List, genres, search, seasons/episodes) with playback delegated to a trusted DRM client — the Netflix app / Edge (PlayReady SL3000, up to 4K on Windows) in "delegate" mode, or a bundled VMP-signed Electron (Widevine privacy mode, 1080p, integrated subtitles) in "embedded" mode. No in-addon DRM, no key handling: each user signs in to their own account and playback runs in a client Netflix already trusts.
